title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under peer influence, policy mandates, media messaging, enforcement, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Neighbors influence each other's mask attitudes and decisions via conversations and observed behavior.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast
interactions.description: Government agency announces mask mandates/guidelines that affect perceived norms and compliance costs.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media messages shift risk perception and mask attitudes depending on reach, bias, and misinformation.

interactions.name: purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: People acquire masks from retailers subject to price and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: enforcement_check
interactions.description: Locations or government agents check compliance; non-compliant individuals face penalties or denial of entry.

interactions.name: location_entry
interactions.description: People visit locations; mask requirement and enforcement affect whether they wear masks during the visit.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing masks in required or public contexts over time.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days until overall mask adoption reaches the target threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: location_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Average fraction of visitors wearing masks in locations with requirements.

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of days retailers experience mask inventory at zero.

metrics.name: enforcement_incidents_rate
metrics.description: Number of enforcement incidents per 1,000 location visits.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy level changes, measured pre- vs post-policy shift.

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity
validation_criteria.description: Increasing policy level and enforcement should not decrease steady-state adoption (monotonic response).

validation_criteria.name: no_influence_stability
validation_criteria.description: With peer/policy/media influences set to zero, adoption should remain near the initial rate aside from random noise.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate time series should stabilize (change below a small epsilon) by the end of the simulation under constant parameters.
